# What survived the status update?

Move eight explicit facts through three attention-limited reporting layers. Each layer carries whole facts in the chosen order while they fit. Later layers cannot recover omitted facts; timed source requests can. An inspectable rule decides hold, pilot or launch from available facts, alongside the same rule with all facts.

Edit original facts, their attention costs, each layer’s order and budget, source requests and the missing-evidence policy. Matched comparisons replay reporting arrangements on the current facts and costs. The routine-release scenario shows that concise reports can preserve a decision while requiring less reading.

This is fact selection, with no language understanding or subjective score. `model.test.js` exercises omission traces, irreversible upstream loss, retrieval deadlines, rule precedence, bounded validation and matched comparisons. Native and article views share the pure projection.

Inspired by [John Cutler, AI and the Recontextualization Tax](https://cutlefish.substack.com/p/tbm-437-ai-and-the-recontextualization).
